decisions.sourceScope: WETH total minted supply at a finalized Ethereum block multiplied by a separately approved WETH/USD reference price; this is not circulating market cap
requiredInputs: WETH totalSupply at an explicit finalized block
exact integer arithmetic and declared scales
decisions.methodology: Potential deterministic derivation: market value = exact WETH totalSupply atoms at block b × approved USD-per-WETH price at the same declared asOf, with integer fixed-point multiplication and explicit rounding. This yields total-supply-based wrapped-asset value, not current MARKET_CAP_REPORTED/circulating basis.

decisions.sourceScope: Candidate describes aggregate cryptoasset 24-hour spot turnover across tracked exchanges; exact WETH historical window endpoints and complete coverage are unverified
requiredInputs: explicit market/venue universe and spot-only policy
windowStart and windowEnd exactly 24 hours apart
decisions.methodology: Do not use UTC daily candle volume as rolling VOLUME_24H. CoinMarketCap describes an aggregate 24-hour spot measure and screening, but reviewed public docs do not bind each historical point to an exact rolling window start/end and asOf. If only UTC buckets can be proven, change and version the product metric contract explicitly.
